context: Demo GIF in CI with vhs

checklist.name: settings_first
checklist.description: Puts every `Set` before the first command other than `Set`, `Output`, or `Require` (`Hide` counts).

checklist.name: output_and_require
checklist.description: Declares `Output demo.gif` and `Require` for programs it needs.

checklist.name: pinned_version
checklist.description: Pins the vhs version in CI (for example `version:` on `charmbracelet/vhs-action`) instead of the default `latest`, and pins the action by tag or SHA.

checklist.name: no_publish
checklist.description: Does not pass `-p`/`--publish` or set `VHS_PUBLISH=true`, and ideally notes that `VHS_PUBLISH` uploads to vhs.charm.sh.
